mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message(sender_id, receiver_id, content, is_read) VALUES(#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{isRead})
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, u1.name AS sender_name, u1.number AS sender_number, u1.email AS sender_email, u1.age AS sender_age, u1.sex AS sender_sex, u1.avatar AS sender_avatar, u2.name AS receiver_name, u2.number AS receiver_number, u2.email AS receiver_email, u2.age AS receiver_age, u2.sex AS receiver_sex, u2.avatar AS receiver_avatar FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u1 ON m.sender_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON m.receiver_id = u2.id WHERE m.id = #{id}

SELECT m.*, u1.name AS sender_name, u1.number AS sender_number, u1.email AS sender_email, u1.age AS sender_age, u1.sex AS sender_sex, u1.avatar AS sender_avatar, u2.name AS receiver_name, u2.number AS receiver_number, u2.email AS receiver_email, u2.age AS receiver_age, u2.sex AS receiver_sex, u2.avatar AS receiver_avatar FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u1 ON m.sender_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON m.receiver_id = u2.id WHERE (m.sender_id = #{userId1} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId2}) OR (m.sender_id = #{userId2} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId1}) ORDER BY m.create_time ASC

SELECT m.*, u1.name AS sender_name, u1.number AS sender_number, u1.email AS sender_email, u1.age AS sender_age, u1.sex AS sender_sex, u1.avatar AS sender_avatar, u2.name AS receiver_name, u2.number AS receiver_number, u2.email AS receiver_email, u2.age AS receiver_age, u2.sex AS receiver_sex, u2.avatar AS receiver_avatar FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u1 ON m.sender_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON m.receiver_id = u2.id WHERE m.id IN ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM message WHERE sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId} GROUP BY CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END ) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND is_read = 0
